From the commit range https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/compare/a0a8ce681afda6b662e450ac9532b0d4c125520c...cae9bce1ff1ad20df8f8340ed5a25b96fc5db4e1 the https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/89518 looks like a suspect. cc @eiriktsarpalis 

Intel/x64/Windows:
- https://github.com/dotnet/perf-autofiling-issues/issues/20263
Intel/x64/Ubuntu:
- https://github.com/dotnet/perf-autofiling-issues/issues/20244
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/89518 is unlikely to have caused this. It only touches diagnostics on the source generator.

Having run git-bisect it appears that the culprit is https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/89418. This is adding custom attribute resolution in a few more places, but I'm very surprised by the extent of the regression this is causing. Will investigate further.

> cc https://github.com/orgs/dotnet/teams/area-system-reflection @stephentoub if you can recommend a workaround for less expensive attribute resolution.

I assume this is one-time use only and the results are cached in some form.

I'd have to look at the implementation; obtaining custom attributes from members (vs. a Type) is roughly the same cost for both overloads of `GetCustomAttributes()`.
Please log a reflection perf issue; needs investigation.
